name: Frame of Atiesh
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Gives 6,600 experience instead of 9,550, 0.69 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
With the frame formed, Atiesh is nearly whole. Only the head and base of the staff are now missing. There is also a minor issue regarding the staff being a conduit for Sargeras's evil.

Find someone that can assist you in locating the remaining pieces and exorcising the evil from the staff.
narrative.objectives: Find someone that will help you in recovering the last two pieces of the staff and ridding it of evil.
narrative.offerRewardText: The archmages have died.Do not mourn their passing, adventurer. All such things are fated. Just as you holding the staff of the Guardian was fated...
